record.original_question: If X is a cubic threefold and Ku(X) is the Kuznetsov component appearing in the standard semiorthogonal decomposition of Db(X), is Ku(X) indecomposable?

evidence.quote: Question 2.13. Is Ku(X) indecomposable, when X is a cubic threefold?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X \subset \mathbb{P}^4_{\mathbb{C}}$ be a smooth cubic threefold, and let $D^b(X)$ denote the bounded derived category of coherent sheaves on $X$. Let $H$ denote the hyperplane class. There is a semiorthogonal decomposition
$$D^b(X) = \langle \mathrm{Ku}(X),\, \mathcal{O}_X,\, \mathcal{O}_X(H) \rangle,$$
where the Kuznetsov component is defined by
$$\mathrm{Ku}(X) = \{ E \in D^b(X) : \mathrm{Hom}^\bullet(\mathcal{O}_X, E) = 0 = \mathrm{Hom}^\bullet(\mathcal{O}_X(H), E)\}.$$
A $\mathbb{C}$-linear triangulated category $\mathcal{T}$ is said to be (semiorthogonally) indecomposable if it admits no nontrivial semiorthogonal decomposition $\mathcal{T} = \langle \mathcal{A}, \mathcal{B} \rangle$ with both $\mathcal{A}$ and $\mathcal{B}$ nonzero admissible subcategories.

Question: Is the Kuznetsov component $\mathrm{Ku}(X)$ indecomposable for every smooth cubic threefold $X$?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not return a definitive proof or disproof of the indecomposability of the Kuznetsov component of a smooth cubic threefold. The Kuznetsov component is widely studied (stability conditions, categorical Torelli, moduli spaces), but indecomposability in the sense of admitting no nontrivial semiorthogonal decomposition does not appear to have a published resolution in the sources surveyed; the question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: A categorical invariant for cubic threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: The non-trivial part of a semi-orthogonal decomposition of D^b(X) for a cubic threefold X characterizes its isomorphism class (categorical Torelli).
status_evidence.claim: Ku(X) determines a cubic threefold but its semiorthogonal indecomposability is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Stability conditions on Kuznetsov components
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of Bridgeland stability conditions on Ku(X) for Fano threefolds and cubic fourfolds.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work focuses on stability conditions rather than proving indecomposability of Ku(X) for cubic threefolds.

status_evidence.title: Stability manifolds of Kuznetsov components of prime Fano threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the stability manifold of Ku(X) for prime Fano threefolds.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on Ku(X) does not record a resolution of the indecomposability question.
